text:
maria: Heads up — customer 'AcmeAnalytics' reported mass deprovisioning of a dozen service accounts after yesterday's KMS key rotation. Noticed via missing RBAC entries and failed jobs.

devon: omg, saw alert. Is this the same KMS alias swap we rolled last night? :thinking_face:

maria: Yes, rotation window 02:00 UTC. They said SCIM webhooks showed 200 but provisioning records are empty. Audit logs from the SCIM service are sparse.

alex: Quick checklist: 1) KMS key alias swap completed 02:04. 2) Provisioner logs show successful POST -> 202 for deprovision requests. 3) downstream auth errors when trying to decrypt ext_id.

security-oncall: Can you paste the exact error from the provisioner?

alex: Sure — log tail below: 
```
2026-03-22T02:07:10Z provisioner ERROR decrypt ext_id failed: kms.Decrypt: InvalidCiphertextException: CMK not found for keyId arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1111-aaaa-2222-bbbb
```

devon: That looks like requests were signed with the old key but alias points to new CMK. Could be envelope format mismatch (we use JWE with KMS).

maria: The weird bit: some accounts were fine, others dropped. Hypothesis: stale cached encryption contexts + partial cache flush during rollout.

security-oncall: If KMS returned InvalidCiphertext, SCIM provisioner likely can't decrypt external IDs -> treats users as unknown -> deprov. We need to confirm whether the ext_id was re-encrypted during rotation or left alone.

alex: I pulled the backup. Encrypted ext_id blobs look like two distinct formats — old envelope prefix vs new. Sample: 
```
old: ENC:AESGCM:...|ctx:v1|...
new: ENC:KMSJWE:...|ctx:v2|...
```

devon: Uh — the migration tool was supposed to rewrap all ext_ids during rotation but apparently only ran for 60% of tenants before hitting rate limits. That matches partial impact.

maria: Customer-facing impact: some scheduled jobs failed with 403s and alerted their SRE. They opened a P1. We should escalate to incident channel and notify account team.

security-oncall: Steps: 1) Pause auto-deprovision workflow (temp flag) to stop further churn. 2) Re-run rewrap job for tenant every ext_id. 3) Backfill audit log entries for any lost actions so compliance has chain-of-custody. 4) Postmortem and vuln triage for migration tool rate limiting.

alex: I've pushed a kill-switch flag to prod: 
```
PATCH /config/flags {"scim.auto_deprovision": false}
```
Response 200.

devon: I can spin the rewrap job now in batch mode with higher concurrency and smaller batches to avoid KMS throttling. Will route through rate-limiter service. ETA first pass ~90 minutes.

maria: Please add verbose logging to the job so we can generate deterministic audit events showing rewrap success per ext_id. Compliance will need those logs.

security-oncall: Also file a KMS incident with cloud infra — if the CMK alias switch propagation delay caused some clients to still reference the old ARN, we need to know propagation guarantees. Ticket in cloud-ops created: CLOUDF-9876.

alex: Noted — I've collected a sample of 8 affected ext_id blobs and corresponding request traces and attached to the CLOUDF ticket.

devon: Rewrap job started. Rolling 5 tenants at a time, backoff on KMS 429/Throttling. I will stream progress here.

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] Rewrap job v2.1 started by devon in namespace scim-backfill. JobID: rb-20260322-42.

maria: Also a reminder — RBAC changes tied to ext_id are sensitive. We should avoid blind deprovisioning until backfill confirms decrypt success. Good call on the flag.

security-oncall: For postmortem: include timeline, root cause (partial rewrap due to rate limit), mitigation (flag + rewrap), and long-term mitigation (atomic key-rotate rewrap, stronger preflight verification, and audit lag monitoring).

alex: Forensics note: audit log gaps happened because the provisioner only writes audit events after decrypt step. We'll add a fallback log entry when decrypt fails so we have visibility even if deprov is attempted.

devon: Rewrap pass 1: 60% complete, 0 errors besides transient 429s. Patch to retry/backoff landed.

maria: Devon — after pass 2 completes, can you coordinate with account team to re-enable auto_deprovision for that tenant only after we confirm audit backfill?

devon: Yep. I'll also generate a CSV with user ids + rewrap_status for them.

security-oncall: One security question for design: do we need per-tenant KMS CMKs instead of single multi-tenant alias to reduce blast radius? Put that in the vuln triage doc.

maria: +1. Add cost/ops tradeoffs.

sre-bot: [alert] Customer AcmeAnalytics reported resumed job success after partial rewrap. Ticket ACME-334 updated.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll draft an incident update for the workspace and include next steps and compliance artifacts.

maria: Great work — keep streaming progress. :thumbsup:

devon: pass 2 done. Full rewrap 100%. Generating audit backfill now. ETA 20m.

security-oncall: Once backfill is uploaded, we should mark incident resolved and schedule a blameless postmortem.

maria: Closing note — create a safe-runbook item: "Key rotation -> preflight verify rewrap completeness -> only then flip alias -> enable auto-deprovision". I'll put it in runbooks repo.

alex: Incident update posted to #incidents and ACME account slack. Closing thread here unless new issues crop up.

maria: thanks all.
